issues.problem: Minor interpretive caveat: FY2023 net income included a ~$5.9B one-time non-cash tax benefit (valuation allowance release), which inflates the YoY decline. Operating margin pressure was real (about 9.2% to 7.2%) but smaller than the 52.7% drop implies.

data.summary: All figures (revenue, net income, operating cash flow, cash, total assets, total liabilities) match Tesla's reported FY2023/FY2024 results, and the percentage changes are correct. The only caveat is that the FY2023 tax benefit partly explains the net income decline.
